patch.value: item mutate --dry-run does not surface per-row advisory duplicate-detection warnings

Bulk create rows run the full SDK create path, so governance.duplicate_detection_mode applies per row: strict refuses and advisory records a warning. The staged preview behind pm item mutate --dry-run only reports validated true or false and discards the per-row advisory warnings, so an agent importing a document under advisory mode never sees which rows look like existing items before committing. Surface the advisory similarity warnings in the dry-run receipt, keyed by row index and ref, without changing the configured policy.

pm item mutate --dry-run on a document whose create rows resemble existing items under duplicate_detection_mode advisory lists each advisory warning with the row index and ref in the receipt, and strict mode still refuses the same rows.
